en: The postcard shows a historical street scene with classic European architecture, including ornate buildings and a cobblestone street. There is a horse-drawn carriage and several people on the sidewalk. Visible signage includes 'Restaurant im Ratskeller' and 'Tapeten-Handlung von R...' as well as advertisements for 'Linoleum, Wachstuche, Teppiche.' The image is monochrome, likely from the early 20th century.
